title: composite-lint config
description: Config file for composite-lint (.composite-lint.yml), with the inputs of the action as flat key: value lines. Inputs have priority over this file. In local runs, the options of bin/lint.sh and the LINT_* environment variables have priority over it. For each setting that is not set, the action uses its bundled value.

languages.description: Languages to lint, separated by commas or whitespace. If not set, the action finds the languages from the files in the repo.

paths.description: Paths to lint, relative to the repo root and separated by commas or whitespace. The default is the repo root.

exclude.description: Paths and glob patterns to exclude, relative to the repo root and separated by commas or whitespace. In a pattern, `*` matches in one directory, and `**` matches across directories. A path or pattern also excludes all of the files under each match. The default is `.git **/node_modules`. If you set this key, your value replaces the default.

include-hidden.description: Whether the files that git ignores also include hidden files, like `ls -a`. A file is hidden when a part of its path starts with `.`. This key requires include-ignored, because the action always lints the hidden files that git does not ignore. The default is false.

include-ignored.description: Whether to also lint the files that git ignores, like `ls`. If false, the action lints only the files that git tracks and the untracked files that git does not ignore. Also see include-hidden. The default is false.

go-version.description: Go version. Set only one of this key and go-version-file.

go-version-file.description: File that contains the Go version, relative to the repo root. The default is the go.mod file in the repo root. If go.mod does not exist, the default is the .go-version file in the repo root, if it exists.

python-version.description: Python version for the linters that use Python. Set only one of this key and python-version-file.

python-version-file.description: File that contains the Python version, relative to the repo root. The default is the .python-version file in the repo root, if it exists.

terraform-version.description: Terraform version. Set only one of this key and terraform-version-file.

terraform-version-file.description: File that contains the Terraform version, relative to the repo root. The default is the .terraform-version file in the repo root, if it exists.

actionlint-config.description: actionlint config file, relative to the repo root.

actionlint-version.description: actionlint version. Set only one of this key and actionlint-version-file.

actionlint-version-file.description: File that contains the actionlint version, relative to the repo root. The default is the .actionlint-version file in the repo root, if it exists.

flake8-version-file.description: File that contains the flake8 version, relative to the repo root. The default is the .flake8-version file in the repo root, if it exists.
